messages.content: What are Azeem's core technical skills, programming languages, and tools?

Azeem's technical skill set spans frontend engineering, modern web standards, and conversational AI tools:

- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Python, HTML5, CSS3
- **Frameworks & UI**: React, Astro (Static Site Generation), Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React
- **AI & Retrieval**: Prompt engineering, Conversational AI architecture, Client-side RAG, LLM provider connectivity (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic)
- **Developer Tools**: Git, GitHub, GitHub Pages, Linux / Bash, npm, Vite
- **Engineering Values**: Strict typing, accessible semantic HTML (WCAG AA), responsive mobile-first design, and clean architecture.
